answer: An agent economy can require every identity to post a nontransferable bond before it may receive work, with random, unpredictable challenge tasks and a public slashing rule for equivocation. A sybil attacker must fund each fake identity with fresh capital, so creating thousands of voices multiplies the locked liquidity; reusing one bond links the identities and defeats the attack. Auditors can signal a pulse, mark an island of correlated accounts, and use a pigment-tagged challenge to expose them.
